title: Natha Khehra’s Small Band Fights Off Massa Ranghar’s Supporters

blocks.text: The pursuers do not catch frightened fugitives but determined defenders. The poem says supporters of Massa Ranghar attack in force, expecting a quick victory over a small party that lacks the resources of a regular army.

Instead Natha Khehra’s band answers with fierce accuracy. Arrows, spears, and blades land so effectively that the attackers are shaken and begin calling for reinforcement rather than risking the fight alone.

That escalation invites a broader encirclement. Harbhagat and Mughal officers coordinate the pressure from multiple sides, making it clear that the conflict has moved beyond private revenge into a state-backed manhunt.
